component.name: Key Light Control
component.summary: Control Elgato Key Lights on your network

description.p: Adjust your Elgato Key Lights from a Linux desktop. Discover lights automatically on your local network and control power, brightness, and color temperature.

ul.li: Control individual lights or toggle all lights together
Rename lights and save your preferences
Use tray menus for quick lighting changes
Bind the included toggle command to a desktop keyboard shortcut

description.p: This community project is independent of Elgato. Your computer and lights must be on a network that allows multicast DNS discovery.
Bundle desktop controls, tray actions, and a portable toggle command in a Flatpak.
